copy.headline: Trackdown: Help find Dallas rapper BFG Baandz’s killer
copy.caption: Dallas police are searching for two suspects caught on camera in the fatal shooting of local rap artist Kenneth Turner Jr., known as BFG Baandz, earlier this year.
